accepted_facts: R1 through R6 remain closed and are not reopened by this correction.
The current executable artifact set contains exactly four existing Cargo binaries: substrate-lifecycle-linux, world-service, substrate-gateway, and substrate.
The current mac.lima.guest-binary(world) role names /usr/local/bin/world even though the world package has no binary target and no current installer or release producer was found.
The canonical installer lacks a complete pre-Stage-1 production and staging route for the required existing Linux artifacts.
The canonical installer does not currently connect the already-landed direct publisher bootstrap result to the fixed lima-warm Stage-1 path.
Evidence attempt 9 restored all native state and did not begin native mutation.
selected_direction: Use the already-landed R5 and R6 authority, manifest, direct-bootstrap, Stage-1, and closed post-PM request mechanisms.
Build and stage only the four existing Cargo binaries; do not create, alias, or rename a binary target.

Remove only the unsupported mac.lima.guest-binary(world) artifact role and its /usr/local/bin/world manifestation after exact source and consumer verification; preserve the world crate, world CLI concept, and unrelated world behavior.
Wire the canonical installer to the existing direct publisher bootstrap and execute only the closed signed Stage-1 and post-PM requests already returned by the landed implementation.
Make only the minimum existing-contract adjustment required to bind the four fixed artifacts; do not introduce a new authority model.
